errors.namingPattern: Use up to 64 characters with '{nn}' or '{n}', so every device gets its own name.

segmentation.title: Typical segmentation
segmentation.description: Creates a VLAN, a /24 subnet with gateway and a zone per segment, tags them on the router port and adds basic firewall rules. Existing rules keep their priority.
